snippet.title: Psalm 2 - Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
ADD to Whishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3916260/Psalm_2

A first-person psychological horror game where the elevator is the only safe place. Each floor presents a new reality. Each floor presents a new inhabitant. Find them to continue your descent.
